description: Detect repeated sentence takes (retakes) in a word timeline using token similarity within a time window, and plan removal of all but the kept take. Returns take groups, removal and keep ranges, and apply routes. Local-only; never changes Premiere.

frame_rate.description: Timebase used to snap ranges to whole frames; defaults to 30.

handle_frames.description: Frames of handle left inside each removal so cuts are not tight; defaults to 1.

keep.description: Which take in each group to keep; defaults to last.

max_gap_seconds.description: Only sentences starting within this many seconds of an earlier candidate are compared; defaults to 20.

max_groups.description: Maximum take groups to return; defaults to 64.

min_words.description: Minimum tokens a sentence needs before it is compared; defaults to 4.

similarity_threshold.description: Token Jaccard/containment similarity needed to group two sentences; defaults to 0.8.

word_timeline.description: Caller-supplied word-timed transcript for one Premiere source item. Words must be ordered by start time and bound to the transcript revision returned by get_clip_transcript_uxp. Different labeled speakers may overlap; same-speaker words may not, even when another speaker is between them.

words.description: Ordered word tokens with source-time boundaries.

name: detect_repeated_takes

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Detect Repeated Takes
